prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1136; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came. My head snapped to one side, and I felt a sharp pain in my neck that has continued since then. I gave the same description of how the collision happened to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster on the phone, and to the medical staff who examined me, and nothing I have said has changed. I am staying with the policyholder, who is a family member and lives in the same household, and I am driving the vehicle with their permission. I would appreciate prompt review of this claim so that I can get the treatment my neck strain requires.
